purpose: Record primary-source evidence for SBI-linked recurring XRP acquisition and reward-distribution channels, market-making relationships, and the group's simultaneous Circle/USDC and Ripple/XRPL rails.

sources.title: Crypto-asset Exchange — SBI VC Trade
claims: SBI states that its exchange handles XRP.
SBI describes an Accumulation Service that automatically purchases selected crypto-assets on a regular schedule using a predetermined amount and frequency.
limitations: No XRP-specific subscriber count, purchase volume, execution venue, order-flow amount, or asset-selection share is disclosed.
The product description does not establish whether purchases are sourced from open-market execution, internal inventory, or another liquidity arrangement.

sources.publisher: SBI VC Trade, APLUS and Visa Japan
sources.title: SBI VISA Crypto Card — BTC, ETH or XRP rewards
claims: Card applicants can select one reward asset from BTC, ETH or XRP.
Accumulated card points are automatically exchanged into the selected crypto-asset once per month, with no exchange fee stated in the release.
The card can also be used for SBI Securities credit-card mutual-fund accumulation, with crypto rewards accruing based on the investment amount.
The May 2026 launch campaign offered temporary elevated reward rates; those campaign dates have expired.
limitations: The release does not disclose the percentage of customers selecting XRP, XRP reward units distributed, total reward value, or how SBI sources the XRP.
The temporary May–August 2026 campaign must not be represented as a currently active promotion.
Reward conversion is a distribution mechanism, not proof of net open-market XRP buying.

sources.publisher: SBI VC Trade and Orient Corporation
sources.title: Orico Points can be exchanged for BTC, ETH or XRP
claims: From July 31, 2026, eligible Orico Point members can exchange 1,200 points for 1,000 yen worth of BTC, ETH or XRP through an SBI VC Trade account.
The crypto-asset amount is calculated using the VCTRADE sales price at the specified following-month valuation time and is credited to the customer's account.
limitations: No XRP-specific redemption count, aggregate value, customer selection share, or sourcing method is disclosed.
The program is an opt-in points redemption channel, not a published market-buy schedule.

sources.title: SBI VC Trade corporate profile and ownership
claims: SBI's corporate profile states that SBI Group holds 100% of the voting rights in SBI VC Trade as of June 23, 2026.
limitations: Ownership establishes group control, not the amount of XRP owned, purchased, or held for customers.

sources.title: B2C2 market-maker business and SBI VC Trade connection
claims: SBI states that B2C2 became a consolidated subsidiary on December 15, 2020.
SBI states that B2C2 has been connected to SBI VC Trade since September 2020 and that SBI VC Trade daily trading volume increased tenfold after the connection.
limitations: The tenfold comparison is a company-reported historical aggregate, not an independently measured current figure.
The page does not isolate XRP pairs, current XRP order-book depth, bid–ask spreads, market-maker inventory, or B2C2's share of XRP turnover.

sources.title: Conceptual proof of concept for tokenized deposits and deposit-backed digital money
claims: SBI Ripple Asia described a conceptual model combining SBI MoneyTap and its token-issuance platform, with XRPL as the proposed blockchain.
SBI Ripple Asia is a joint venture established by SBI Holdings and Ripple.
limitations: The announcement describes a conceptual proof of concept, not a production deposit-token network.
No production settlement volume, bank participation, XRP bridge usage, or XRP collateral requirement is disclosed.

sources.title: Joint venture with Circle Internet Holdings
claims: SBI Holdings announced a joint venture with Circle Internet Holdings to promote USDC circulation and new Web3/digital-finance use cases in Japan.
SBI states that the group acquired USD 50 million of Circle shares as a strategic investor in connection with Circle's NYSE listing.
limitations: The equity investment is in Circle, not XRP, and does not establish a purchase of XRP or an XRP reserve.
The joint venture does not imply that SBI has chosen Circle's network exclusively.

sources.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet
claims: Circle announced Arc mainnet with USDC-denominated gas fees and a founding-validator cohort that includes SBI Group.
Circle lists Coinbase among the digital-asset exchanges providing access to Arc.
Circle describes USDC, EURC and tokenized assets as core Arc assets.
limitations: Founding-validator status does not establish transaction volume or capital deployed by SBI.
Coinbase's presence in the Arc exchange list does not establish a Coinbase–SBI partnership.
Arc's USDC gas model does not require XRP as the network fee asset.

sources.title: SBI VC Trade begins handling RLUSD in Japan
claims: SBI VC Trade announced RLUSD handling beginning June 24, 2026, describing it as a Japan-first Type IV electronic payment instrument under its legal classification.
SBI and Ripple describe the listing as a result of their longstanding partnership.
limitations: The announcement establishes listing availability, not RLUSD balances, payment volume, or XRP demand.
The announcement alone does not establish that SBI VC Trade supports RLUSD deposits or withdrawals on XRPL; network-specific support must be checked separately.

sources.publisher: SBI Holdings, SBI Shinsei Bank, SBI Shinsei Trust, SBI VC Trade and Startale
sources.title: JPYSC trust-type yen stablecoin launch
claims: SBI Shinsei Trust is the issuer of JPYSC, while SBI VC Trade handles distribution.
The initial launch was limited to balances within SBI VC Trade accounts; the release described public-chain circulation as a later step after legal and tax practice was clarified.
Startale Group participated in joint development.
limitations: The release does not establish that JPYSC is live on XRPL or Circle Arc.
Initial account-limited distribution is not public-chain transaction volume.

sources.title: Tracked exchange-wallet balances for SBI VC Trade
claims: The provider reports approximately 59.5 million XRP across two wallets classified as SBI VC Trade at its 2026-10-31 08:00 UTC snapshot.
The provider reports a same-wallet balance change of approximately -899,000 XRP over seven days and -10.5 million XRP over 30 days.
limitations: Wallet labels and balances are provider-derived, not an official SBI proof-of-reserves statement.
Exchange wallets may contain pooled customer custody, operational reserves and internal transfers; balance changes are not equivalent to net customer selling, net buying, or tradable float.

sources.title: 2026 fiscal-year-end shareholder benefit program
claims: SBI Holdings announced an option for eligible shareholders recorded at March 31, 2026 to receive a coupon redeemable for a stated yen value of XRP in an SBI VC Trade account, or to select a product set.
The announcement states a JPY 2,000-equivalent XRP coupon for the first described eligibility tier and gives a July 31, 2026 application deadline.
limitations: The stated application deadline has passed; this is historical evidence, not an active October 2026 offer.

The announcement does not disclose total eligible shareholders, XRP units distributed, aggregate redemption value, XRP procurement source, or whether SBI made open-market purchases to fulfill coupons.
Do not conflate this SBI Holdings shareholder program with similarly named shareholder benefits offered by SBI Global Asset Management, a separate group company.

independence_policy.rule: SBI corporate pages and releases are primary sources but not independent corroboration of one another. Circle's Arc announcement is a separate issuer source. XRP Insights is a third-party wallet-classification provider and is not treated as an official SBI source.
independence_policy.no_market_flow_inference: Product availability, rewards, account balances and market capitalization must not be substituted for reconciled executed XRP purchase/sale flow.
